The '''sienta tree''' grew in the rocky [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of the [[Hanna Wild Game Reserve]], a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] area on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sienta [[Tree/Legends|tree]] was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
